speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs since the Foreign Interference (Countermeasures) Act 2021 came into full force on 29 December 2023 and with the wide drafting of some of the provisions of the Act, what options are available to politically significant persons who wish to seek clarifications about complying with provisions of the Act, especially those beyond the guidelines which are periodically issued by the Registrar of Foreign and Political Disclosures.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: We have also seen, both in Singapore and overseas, examples of how these threats can be manifested, including through journalists and academics.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Interactions with Politically Significant Persons (PSPs), which may, at first glance, appear normal, may in fact be a vector for foreign interference.
